title: maint.event.v1{kind=backup_model_lineage_drift}
description: Phase 8 §8.13.1 — emitted when a live model artifact under data/models/ is missing its lineage sidecar or the sidecar predictor_id/version fields do not match the enclosing directory structure. Notification only.

artifact_path.description: Path of the artifact relative to data/models/.

predictor_id.description: predictor_id inferred from the directory structure.

version.description: version inferred from the directory structure.

drift_reason.description: Root cause of the lineage drift.
